Figure 1. Schematics for the synthesis of Mo–N/C@MoS2 and corresponding TEM images; scale: 50 nm. a) Room-temperature self-assembly of
metal–organic clusters into ZIF-8. b) Carbonization of ZIF-8 in to N-doped carbon framework (N/C), followed by hydrothermal evolution of vertically
aligned MoS2 nanosheet array. c) Final carbonization leads to the formation of the Mo–N/C@MoS2 hybrid.
